```yaml
name: Regression Tests

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  # Parallel test groups (fast, network, slow, core)
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        python-version: [3.8, 3.9, 3.10, 3.11, 3.12]
        test-group: [fast, network, slow, core]
      fail-fast: false
      max-parallel: 20
    name: Test ${{ matrix.test-group }} (py${{ matrix.python-version }})
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python ${{ matrix.python-version }}
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}
          cache: 'pip'

      - name: Install Poetry
        run: |
          pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install poetry

      - name: Cache Poetry dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.cache/pypoetry
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-poetry-${{ hashFiles('poetry.lock') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-poetry-

      - name: Install project dependencies
        run: |
          poetry config virtualenvs.create false
          poetry install --no-interaction --no-root

      - name: Run tests
        run: |
          mkdir -p reports
          poetry run pytest -m "${{ matrix.test-group }}" \
            --junitxml=reports/${{ matrix.test-group }}-${{ matrix.python-version }}.xml
        env:
          PYTEST_ADDOPTS: "--maxfail=1"

      - name: Upload test results to GitHub UI
        uses: dorny/test-reporter@v1
        with:
          name: ${{ matrix.test-group }}-${{ matrix.python-version }}
          path: reports/${{ matrix.test-group }}-${{ matrix.python-version }}.xml
          reporter: java-junit

      - name: Test summary
        uses: test-summary/action@v2
        with:
          paths: reports/${{ matrix.test-group }}-${{ matrix.python-version }}.xml
          output: test-summary-${{ matrix.test-group }}-${{ matrix.python-version }}.txt
          show: true
          folded: false

  # Regression tests (all regression markers)
  regression:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        python-version: [3.8, 3.9, 3.10, 3.11, 3.12]
      fail-fast: false
      max-parallel: 5
    name: Regression (py${{ matrix.python-version }})

      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python ${{ matrix.python-version }}
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5

          cache: 'pip'

      - name: Install Poetry
        run: |

          pip install poetry

      - name: Cache Poetry dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.cache/pypoetry
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-poetry-${{ hashFiles('poetry.lock') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-poetry-

      - name: Install project dependencies
        run: |
          poetry config virtualenvs.create false
          poetry install --no-interaction --no-root

      - name: Run regression tests
        run: |
          mkdir -p reports
          poetry run pytest -m "regression" \
            --junitxml=reports/regression-${{ matrix.python-version }}.xml
        env:
          PYTEST_ADDOPTS: "--maxfail=1"

      - name: Upload regression test results to GitHub UI
```
